bar_proxy_validation.proxy: prior session low <= 0.9 x the close before it, with the pre-split close restated by the split ratio

fade_baseline.definition: Listed common, ordinary or ADS shares (Nasdaq ITCH definitions, listing venue XNAS/XNYS/XASE), prior listing-venue close under $5, prior 20-session three-venue dollar volume between $50,000 and $20,000,000, at least 20 prior printed sessions, no catalogued reverse split within 30 calendar days, and both official auction prints present. Gross short return = 1 - official close / official open on the listing venue. Equal weight per symbol-day.
fade_baseline.price_basis: Official listing-venue opening and closing auction prints (Databento statistics types 1 and 11). Conditioning features (prior close, prior-session return, dollar volume, Rule 201 proxy) come from the listing-venue daily bar and the three-venue volume sum; those bars span pre-market and after-hours prints.

H1.registered_kill: interval covers zero on train and validation
H1.assessment: Kill criterion met: the restricted-minus-unrestricted interval covers zero on train and on validation. Treat both states as one population for the gross return and model Rule 201 as a price constraint in the fill model, not as an admission rule.

H7.assessment: Reported, not promoted: registered as a descriptive baseline.

H8.assessment: Reported, not promoted: registered as descriptive. Positive difference means the registered direction.

train.reading: reversed: larger fade after a +20% close

definitions.short_return_convention: 1 - exit price / entry price; positive means the short gained.
definitions.split: By the entry session date. Train 2018-05-01 to 2022-12-31, validate 2023-01-01 to 2024-12-31, holdout from 2025-01-01 (sealed).
definitions.issuer_interval: 95% percentile interval from 2,000 whole-issuer (CIK) bootstrap draws; events of one issuer move together.
definitions.symbol_interval: 95% percentile interval from 2,000 whole-symbol bootstrap draws over per-symbol sums; a symbol is the issuer proxy for the universe.
definitions.month_interval: 95% percentile interval from 2,000 whole-calendar-month bootstrap draws; sessions of one month move together.
definitions.t_cluster: Point estimate divided by the bootstrap standard error of the difference; a descriptive ratio, not an asymptotic test.
definitions.excess_all: Event return minus the same-session mean fade of all eligible sub-$5 names (at least five names that session).
definitions.excess_bucket: Event return minus the same-session mean fade of eligible names in the same prior-session-return bucket.
definitions.excess_calipers: Event return minus the mean of up to three same-session listed names nearest in log prior close (within x2) and log dollar volume (within x3), no price cap, no catalogued split within 30 days.
definitions.excess_calipers_same_bucket: As excess_calipers, additionally requiring the same prior-session-return bucket.

limits: Gross price behaviour only: no borrow, locate, spread, depth, commission or fill assumption enters any number here.
The universe is listed names on the three venue datasets since 2018-05; OTC and pre-2018 names are absent, and a symbol is used as the issuer cluster.
Conditioning features come from daily bars that include pre-market and after-hours prints; the return itself uses official auction prints.
Three-venue volume understates consolidated volume, so the dollar-volume band is conservative relative to a consolidated definition.
The Rule 201 proxy is a bar-based approximation; the event cohort's SSR state is the cached Nasdaq status and is the authoritative H1 contrast.
Catalogued-split exclusion windows rely on the ledger and the expansion catalogue; an undiscovered split would leave its sessions in the universe.
Matched controls use pre-entry features only; they describe a conditional comparison, not a causal or executable alpha claim.
Holdout results exist only under local/holdout and were not read while writing this document; nothing here was selected on them.
H7 and H8 are descriptive baselines by registration; they are reported, not promoted.
